build_xcit_upernet_config: build a config for XCiT tiny backbone with UPerNet head on ADE20K dataset
create_xcit_model_config: create XCiT model config with patch_size 16, embed_dim 192, depth 12, 4 heads
configure_adamw_optimizer: configure AdamW optimizer with lr 0.00006, weight_decay 0.01, and custom paramwise decay keys
setup_lr_schedule: setup poly learning rate schedule with linear warmup over 1500 iterations
configure_ade20k_dataset: configure ADE20K semantic segmentation dataset with 150 classes and 2 samples per GPU
